shots.prompt: Premium dark science-fiction animation. Static camera, five seconds, one continuous shot. The powered-off robot stays completely motionless, head bowed, both eye sockets and chest core completely BLACK and UNLIT throughout. Only the copper sparrow moves: it leans from robot knee to tap the black chest glass twice with its beak, then lifts its head and calls upward. Bird breast light glows amber. Two hollow taps, then a lonely echoing three-note metallic chirp. Keep cold blue cathedral lighting. No robot movement or eye illumination. No speech, no text. Real time.

approval_bypass_reason: Correcting the pre-revival continuity of the authorized film.
